notes.title: BIG Demo Update: New Ranked Board!
notes.notes:
Patch Notes for Demo Build 0.13.8862

Mega Updates! 

 NEW NEW NEW- Monarch Hall Ranked Board unlocked! You can now go for a highscore on TWO different ranked leaderboards!
 Upgrades unlocked! Have fun racking up levels and bedazzling your heroes with new equipment and items to get even higher on the leaderboard (But fair warning that a major rebalance is on the horizon)
 Leaderboards and save game have been reset

Other things that we touched to try to make your day a bit better:

 Jump right into Ranked boards! Use the Ranked tab or button on the main menu to jump right into these competitive boards
 King's Monument Ranked Boss Bounty now 10x bigger starting at 1000 points.
 Ranked board end now shows your Leaderboard rank without having to go to map
 Improvements to the On Screen Controller for greater accessibility
 Unlocked locations are more noticeable on the map now, go explore
 Removed purchasable “Coin of Continuation”... you get 3 for now, use them wisely.
 Party Roster Picker now also available at the start of the level, so you don’t have to go into the roster menu for last minute adjustments
 A few more Goals for you to achieve in the demo.. Boop those sheep!
 Language is English only for the time being- We are making some dialogue tweaks, so we have turned off other languages, until we have localization locked down!

notes.title: Patch Notes for Demo Build 0.13.8617
notes.notes:
We just pushed a small update to the demo!

Patch notes for new build 0.13.8617:

 Fixed an issue accessing Leaderboards.
 Fixed an issue in Market Streets where a ball lost in the final battle area would not respawn properly.
 Added Boss Bounty to Ranked play: defeat the boss and the bounty goes up.
 Fixed an issue Fleeing playfields where you'd appear in an unexpected place on the Map.
 Ensured all Mysterious Holes are accessible (not blocked by scenery).
 Added voice emotes to Kid NPCs in Cheapside.

For a full list of past updates, please check out our Trello board here: https://trello.com/c/3wS9NAqD 

I'd also just like to say thank you to everyone who has played the demo and a big thank you to those who have provided feedback and reported bugs.

Have a flippin' good weekend!

notes.title: Patch Notes for Demo Build 0.13.0+8521
notes.notes:
We pushed a small update to our demo to fix a couple issues and add in mouse support: 

 Improved bug with Knights Shield causing multiple heart loss
 Mouse support for menus + control rebinding to mouse for in game controls
 Pausing actually pauses ;)

Thanks again for everyone contributing their feedback and reporting bugs!

notes.title: Patch notes for DEMO build 0.13.0+8504
notes.notes:
Hi folks, 

We just pushed our first update post demo launch! Thank you to everyone who reported bugs and communicated feedback. We can't make any promises but we're trying our best to implement what we can. We hope to have a roadmap available to the public so you can see what our future plans are and what we've addressed so far! 

We have updated the following:

Added more granular gameplay difficulty/accessibility options (custom flipper health, custom enemy health, custom game speed)
Added controls graphics to options menu
Added option to turn off controller vibration
Updated bug reporting instructions to “~” key
Improved mysterious hole locations to reduce chance the Rogue goes for a swim after exiting
Made the name tag for the Kings Monument Ranked board location visible on the map
